messages:
Jordan: Heads up — ACME Cloud wants Net 60 and an annual-upfront split for a 3yr commitment. POC goes live next Tue, so they want billing locked before kickoff. Asking for: Net 60, Year1 50% upfront, remaining annual invoices. Can we get deal-desk review?
Alex: What's the ARR / committed $ and discount requested? Need to check rate card impact.
Monica: Rate card link: https://redwood.internal/rate-cards/standard. Baseline list price for their footprint is $0.004/token equivalent, estimated ARR = $420k.
Alex: Ok. They're asking for a 10% term discount on 3yr commit plus Net 60 and the 50% upfront in year 1.
Eva: Quick note — Net 60 on a new customer requires credit review. We usually do Net 30 for self-serve, Net 45+ needs finance sign-off.
Jordan: Can we propose compromise: 50% upfront (due Net 15), remainder Net 60? That gives us cash cushion and addresses their AP cycles.
Monica: Pricing math: 10% off 3yr drops FY1 cash by ~21% vs. standard. If they do 50% upfront we recover some. Recommend approving if Legal ok with invoicing schedule and Finance does credit check.
Deal Desk: @Jordan thanks. Please submit the quote in Salesforce with bill-to and payment schedule. We can provision conditional approval: Net 60 pending completed credit app + 50% upfront required on PO. We need Legal to sign off on multi-year invoicing clause.
Jordan: Submitted SFDC quote Q-2026-ACME-001 with proposed payment schedule. Tagging @Legal and @Deal Desk for final sign-off.
RevenueBot: Quote Q-2026-ACME-001 created by Jordan. Status: Pending deal-desk review.
Legal: Quick review — we need explicit invoicing milestones in SOW + early termination clause tied to unpaid invoices. Also include "payment schedule" table and PO referencing. If they insist Net 60, add interest at 1.5%/mo after 30 days past due.
Deal Desk: Conditional approved provided: (1) 50% upfront invoice issued Net 15 on PO receipt, (2) credit app completed and accepted by Finance within 10 business days, (3) Legal adds invoicing/missed-payment remedies. We will approve the 10% term discount for a 3yr commit if these hold.
Jordan: Great — I'll push the edits to the quote and loop in Finance for credit app. POC still on for Tue. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Alex: FYI — if finance flags credit risk, fallback is to require full annual upfront for year1. Mentioning to ACME now might slow the deal.
Jordan: Acknowledged. I'll try the upfront/Net15 + Net60 split first and keep backup option ready.
Eva: I'll start the credit check now. Update once done.
Deal Desk: Please add final checklist to the SFDC opportunity: credit_status, legal_signoff, invoice_schedule_confirmed. We'll do final emoji approval in thread. :)
